title: Two Prizes, Two Sciences
paragraphs: Marie Curie was born in Warsaw in eighteen sixty seven. As a young woman, she moved to Paris to study science. There, she met a scientist named Pierre Curie, and they married and worked together. She worked very hard and rarely took a day off.

The Curies studied a strange kind of energy that comes from some materials. From a dark rock, they found two new elements: polonium and radium. Marie named polonium after her home country, Poland. Their laboratory was small, but their ideas were big.

In nineteen oh three, she shared the Nobel Prize in Physics with her husband and another scientist. In nineteen eleven, she won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry on her own. She is still the only person to win Nobel Prizes in two different sciences. Many young scientists still look up to her.
